title: Gaps and Rings in an ALMA Survey of Disks in the Taurus Star-forming Region
question: What are the properties and likely origins (planets vs condensation fronts) of dust gaps and rings in 12 Taurus disks with substructure from an unbiased high-resolution ALMA 1.33 mm survey?

what.value: Pre-ALMA 1.33 mm fluxes for Taurus disks (comparison; fluxes for the other 20 disks in dust mass plot)

evidence.quote: adopted from (cite: andrews2013) for the other Taurus members

what.value: Spectral types and stellar luminosities (updated to Gaia distances)

evidence.quote: Spectral type and stellar luminosity are adopted from the listed references ((cite: herczeg2014) and Liu et al. submitted)

what.value: Condensation temperatures for N2, CO and clathrate ice

evidence.quote: The condensation temperatures, adopted from (cite: zhang2015)

recipe.method: CASA pipeline-script calibration, phase and amplitude self-calibration, TCLEAN imaging
Fit elliptical Gaussian with IMFIT for major axis; inspect radial profile; reduced chi2 of Gaussian fit to radial profile within central 1.5''; highest chi2 chosen

recipe.goal: Fit visibilities with axisymmetric radial intensity models
recipe.method: Central Gaussian or exponentially tapered power-law plus radial Gaussian rings; Fourier transformed with Galario; MCMC fit with emcee
key_parameters: 100 walkers, 5000 steps, burn-in ~2000; second run 5000 more steps; posterior from last 1000 steps; radial grid 0.0001''-4'' step 0.001''
Uniform priors: ±20 deg for i and PA, ±0.5 arcsec for offsets

recipe.goal: Derive flux, R_eff, gap and ring properties
recipe.method: Integrate best-fit profile; R_eff at 90% flux; gap location at local minimum; gap width full width at half depth; contrast ratio ring peak/gap; uncertainties from 100 chain samples
Optically thin M_dust = D^2 F / (kappa B(T))
assumptions: T_dust = 20 K, optically thin, kappa=2.3 cm2/g (nu/230GHz)^0.4

recipe.goal: Compare gaps with planet-disk interaction expectations
recipe.method: Normalized ring-gap distance vs gap location and stellar mass; planet mass via 4 R_Hill and Rosotti et al. 2016 diagnostic
assumptions: alpha=1e-4 or 1e-2; simulations for 1 Msun star rescaled by mass ratio

recipe.goal: Compare gap locations with ice lines
recipe.method: Midplane temperature from Kenyon & Hartmann irradiated flared disk; ice line radii for N2, CO, clathrate; RADMC-3D check
key_parameters: N2 12-15 K, CO 23-28 K, clathrate CO+N2 41-46 K

evidence.quote: We analyze a total of 19 gap and ring pairs
gaps are located from 10 to 120 au with no preferred distance
The normalized gap-ring distance is typically 0.2–0.3

answer_key.quantity: Planet mass for alpha=1e-4 at diagnostic 0.25

evidence.quote: the diagnostic of 0.25 corresponds to a planet mass $\sim$ 15 M$_\oplus$ (0.05 M$_{\rm J}$)

answer_key.value: 5 near CO; 2 near clathrate CO+N2; 1 near N2; 7 unrelated

evidence.quote: The other seven gaps are unrelated to any of the ice lines we consider here.
